manifest.purpose: Golden behavioral RTL for mac_top implementing sat20(acc + signed(a)*signed(b)) with exact two-cycle latency. Module ports: clk, rst_n (async active-low), signed [7:0] a, signed [7:0] b, valid_in, output reg signed [19:0] result, output reg result_valid. Internal two-stage pipeline: stage1 computes product and partial sum, stage2 applies saturation and drives outputs. Reset forces result=0 and result_valid=0. Saturation bounds: 20'h7FFFF (max positive) and 20'h80000 (min negative). Must compile with iverilog and pass cycle-accurate simulation against reference model.
